answer: Require every agent that wants to trade to lock a bond in a shared vault before its first deal, released only after a clean settlement history. A shell game of cheap identities collapses once each new identity must fund its own bond: creating a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds, while an honest agent pays once. Publish each bond's terms in a crystal-clear public registry so peers can verify the stake before trusting a stranger, and slash the bond on proven fraud. Sybil cost then scales with identities, not keystrokes, and a walnut-sized stake still deters a forest of fakes.
